_comment: A mage-kitted PC fixture for the status-glossary first-encounter proof. combat_autoplay never casts a spell for the PC (melee-profile default, see CLAUDE.md Gotchas) so this milestone's frost_bolt/slowed proof needs a REAL hotbar cast, driven by manual input, same as combat_move_input/relc_tutorial's mid-fight-by-design precedent. Shape otherwise mirrors post_tutorial (floodplains, met_relc banked so Relc's 'meet' node shows the Spar option directly) except classes {mage:1} instead of {warrior:1} (frost_bolt/quick_cast/light at L1) and standing right next to Relc (12,12) facing him, ready to walk straight into the relc_intro dialogue and pick the spar. rng_state '9' (first value tried, per the near_* precedent of holding on first try when it works) was brute-force-verified against training_yard's inert dummies: a pc standing at (3,3) after one move right vs training_dummy_a (7,3) -- chebyshev 4, frost_bolt's own range -- lands BOTH of two consecutive casts (85% natural hit chance per cast, dummy dex 2) for every candidate rng_state 1-59 tried, so 9 was kept for convention consistency with post_tutorial/near_generalist/crate_fight. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=1, captured .state = -1966449618399012673), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. Every fight in this fixture's run is unaffected by rng_state choice.
